subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the sixth term in the same way as the first term is related to the second term and third term is related to fourth term. 

FGH : GJM :: AKC : BNH :: ? : UUV
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• FGH : GJM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f440f53d8d0dcc6e4a86af4928db74900722e7fd7f356cb2cb9b691eea4fc1a.png] 

and

 
• AKC : BNH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2a54ac619ebbdcaa8beb88bcc1fbf850120837019da1f45460a9e7337d899e1.png] 

Similarly,

 
• ? : UUV 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66267e21ebb44c805e6357f2fad679b943425ad72ba57507b0b99d1cfc721914.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"TRQ".**
